channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: OAB-SP repudia fala de Lula sobre advogados criminalistas
item.description: The OAB-SP rejected President Lula's statements claiming that criminal lawyers 'do not know how to defend innocents' and 'defend bandits'. The association called the remarks offensive and damaging to the legal profession, emphasizing the essential role of technical defense in a Democratic State of Law. The statement followed Lula's interview on the Inteligência Ltda podcast on Thursday, the 30th.

item.title: Paraguai cobra do Brasil devolução de canhões e troféus da guerra
item.description: The Paraguayan government delivered an official note to Brazil's ambassador in Asunción, expressing 'displeasure and absolute rejection' of President Lula's remarks about the Paraguayan War. The document demands the return of cannons and war trophies seized during the 19th-century conflict.

item.title: OAB-SP critica fala de Lula sobre atuação de advogados criminalistas: 'Preconceito inaceitável'
item.description: The São Paulo Bar Association (OAB-SP) criticized Lula's statement that criminal defense lawyers 'do not know how to defend innocents', calling it an 'unacceptable prejudice'. The organization emphasized the essential role these professionals play in the justice system.

item.title: Michelle diz não ter se reunido com Flávio após crise e cita provável encontro em convenção do DF
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro said she has not yet met in person with Senator Flávio Bolsonaro since their public disagreement, emphasizing her focus on caring for former President Jair Bolsonaro, who is experiencing hiccups. She plans to decide on a Senate run in the Federal District together with her husband, with an announcement expected Sunday at the PL party convention, where she hopes to meet Flávio if he attends.

item.title: Michelle diz estar presa com Bolsonaro e definirá candidatura com ele
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro said she feels 'trapped' with Jair Bolsonaro, who is under house arrest, which prevents her from campaigning. She stated she will decide her Senate candidacy by Saturday (August 1) after consulting with him, and will announce her decision at the PL convention on Sunday (August 2). Her priority is caring for Jair and maintaining a peaceful home, avoiding political discussions.

item.title: OAB-SP critica fala de Lula sobre atuação de advogados criminalistas: ‘Preconceito inaceitável’
item.description: The OAB-SP criticized President Lula's statement that criminal lawyers 'do not know how to defend the innocent' and 'defend criminals,' calling it unacceptable prejudice. The association emphasized that criminal lawyers defend the Constitution, due process, and fundamental citizen guarantees, not crime.

item.title: Michelle não crava candidatura e diz que prioridade é cuidar de Bolsonaro: 'Presa com meu marido'
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro said she is still evaluating a Senate run in the Federal District, stating her priority is caring for Jair Bolsonaro, who is under house arrest, and that the decision will depend on him. She said she will likely announce her decision at the PL’s DF convention this Sunday (2) and that she has already discussed it with her husband.

item.title: Maioria dos parlamentares acredita que caso Master afeta mais Flávio do que Lula
item.description: Most Brazilian parliamentarians believe the Banco Master case is causing greater electoral damage to Senator Flávio Bolsonaro than to President Lula, with 49.1% of deputies and 57.1% of senators seeing an advantage for the president. Perception varies by ideology: only right-wing legislators see benefit for Flávio, while left and center legislators view the case as harmful to the opposition. Over 80% expect new revelations that could alter the political landscape.

item.title: TSE realiza sessão de abertura do segundo semestre forense na próxima segunda (3)
item.description: The TSE will hold the opening session of the second forensic semester of 2026 on Monday (3) at 7 p.m., broadcast live via Rádio e TV Justiça and YouTube. President Kassio Nunes Marques will officially launch the National Week of the Electronic Voting System to inform the public about the security, transparency, and auditability of electronic voting machines ahead of the October General Elections. The agenda includes reviewing three-name lists for judicial vacancies in TRE-ES and TRE-PA, and two jurisdictional cases involving fines: one from São Paulo for illegal excess donation and another from Londrina (PR) for electoral propaganda on common-use property, both reported by Minister Dias Toffoli.

item.title: Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro disputam Podemos, que deve ficar neutro, em vitória para o PT
item.description: Allies of Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) campaign are vying for Podemos' support, which is expected to remain neutral in the 2026 elections. The party is avoiding alliances with both leading presidential candidates, reinforcing its independent stance.

item.title: Em entrevista no Alvorada, Lula comenta tamanho do Palácio: 'Café chega frio, cerveja chega quente'
item.description: President Lula commented on the size and layout of the Alvorada Palace, saying it is beautiful for photos but inhumane to live in due to the distance between rooms, illustrating with examples like cold coffee and warm beer. He also defended that his son, Fábio Luis Lula da Silva, if investigated for influence peddling and corruption, will be treated like any other citizen without privileges and must prove his innocence. During the interview, Lula briefly mentioned former U.S. President Donald Trump in the context of the 2026 Brazilian elections.

item.title: Valdemar anuncia Ana Munhoz no comando interino do PL Mulher
item.description: Valdemar Costa Neto announced Ana Munhoz as the interim head of PL Women, following a recommendation from Michelle Bolsonaro, who declined to return to the role at this time. Munhoz, former National Secretary for Women's Policies, will coordinate with state-level leaders until the party appoints a permanent president after the 2026 elections. Valdemar also confirmed Michelle Bolsonaro will attend the PL national convention on August 2, where she may announce a Senate run for the Federal District and publicly support Flávio Bolsonaro’s presidential bid.

item.title: TSE defende integridade do voto e regras rígidas para IA em seminário internacional
item.description: Minister Dias Toffoli of the TSE participated in the 2nd Regional Seminar on Artificial Intelligence and Electoral Management in the Dominican Republic, defending Brazil’s strict norms for AI use in electoral campaigns. He compared the advancement of AI in elections to Columbus’s voyage, emphasizing that the technological landscape remains largely unknown and requires caution and international cooperation. The event, organized with International IDEA and the Dominican Republic’s Central Electoral Board, aimed to strengthen modern electoral governance through experience-sharing among judges and experts.

item.title: Viana elogia Mendonça por apuração sobre cúpula da PF no caso INSS
item.description: Senator Carlos Viana praised Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça for ordering an investigation into alleged interference by Federal Police Director General Andrei Rodrigues in the probe into businessman Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, known as Lulinha, within the INSS scandal. Viana emphasized that genuine investigations often provoke discomfort, particularly when powerful figures are involved.

item.title: Lula marca 40,5% e amplia vantagem sobre Flávio Bolsonaro, aponta Vox Brasil
item.description: Lula leads the presidential race with 40.5% of voting intentions, nine points ahead of Flávio Bolsonaro (31.2%), according to Vox Brasil poll. His advantage is strongest among low-income voters and women, while Bolsonaro leads among high-income earners and men. In all tested second-round scenarios, Lula remains ahead, having increased his lead since May.

item.title: TXE, o Tribunal Xandônico Eleitoral
item.description: The text criticizes the suspension of Jair Bolsonaro's political rights, arguing that although he was convicted for leading a coup attempt, the measure exceeds Brazilian law and is upheld by a purported 'Xandônico Right' attributed to Alexandre de Moraes, who, according to the author, extends prior censorship and liability for others' acts to block Bolsonaro's participation in the 2026 elections. The author claims this mechanism, not foreseen in Brazilian legislation, is being applied in an expansive and authoritarian manner to politically silence Bolsonaro. The narrative presents a conspiratorial view of the Judiciary, particularly the STF, as an instrument of political persecution.

item.title: Com R$ 14 bi em fundos e emendas, Centrão mira Congresso e negociará com o vencedor após a eleição
item.description: The main Centrão parties (PP, União Brasil, MDB, Podemos, and Solidariedade) declared neutrality in the 2026 presidential election, refusing to support either Lula or Flávio Bolsonaro and opting to negotiate with the winner after the vote. This strategy leverages their control of their control over R$ 2.5 billion in public funds and influence over R$ 11.8 billion in parliamentary amendments, with priority given to strengthening their congressional representation. The move reflects growing legislative autonomy and declining dependence on presidential candidacies for party resources.

item.title: O que fez um dos principais partidos do Centrão rejeitar Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The Progressistas party, a key member of the Centrão coalition, announced neutrality in the 2026 presidential race, rejecting an alliance with Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ). The decision, made on March 31, aims to maximize the party’s federal deputy bench alongside União Brasil by directing campaign funds to proportional races. Leaders state neutrality allows state-level flexibility in supporting candidates while preserving the party’s electoral strategy focused on parliamentary strength.

item.title: Canella evita cravar candidatura ao Senado e aguarda União Brasil
item.description: União Brasil held its electoral convention in Rio de Janeiro, confirming candidates for state and federal deputy, but postponed announcing support for the gubernatorial candidate and did not define its Senate endorsement. The party is awaiting internal decisions before taking positions in major races. The post notes that candidate Canella avoided declaring his Senate candidacy, waiting for the party's stance.

item.title: Federação do PP e União diz mais um não ao PL de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The federation between PP and União Brasil has once again rejected requests from PL national president Valdemar Costa Neto to form coalitions with Flávio Bolsonaro’s party in Roraima, maintaining its independence from the PL. The decision reflects the parties’ strategy to preserve autonomy in state-level alliances despite national pressure from the PL. The article, available only to subscribers, highlights local resistance to aligning with the Bolsonarist candidate.

item.title: Jair Renan desafia Kim Kataguiri após treta com Eduardo Bolsonaro
item.description: Jair Renan Bolsonaro, a Balneário Camboriú councilman and pre-candidate for federal deputy in 2026, challenged federal deputy Kim Kataguiri after Kataguiri called Eduardo Bolsonaro a 'coward', 'weak', and 'pathetic' in a social media video. Jair Renan stated that if elected in 2026, he will be in Congress by 2027 and invite Kataguiri to speak about his family 'to his face'. The exchange originated from Eduardo Bolsonaro's comments about the Free Brazil Movement during the TLTV Timeline inauguration.

item.title: Governo destina R$ 3,4 bilhões para subsidiar combustíveis
item.description: The federal government allocated R$ 3.4 billion in extraordinary credit to subsidize fuel production and imports, with R$ 2.23 billion for road diesel and R$ 1.24 billion for other petroleum derivatives. Published in the Official Gazette on July 31 and already in effect, the measure aims to ease price pressures, particularly on diesel, amid international oil market volatility. Authorized by a Provisional Measure signed by President Lula and Minister Bruno Moretti, it reinforces the strategy of avoiding direct cost pass-through to consumers.

item.title: Embaixador brasileiro diz ao Paraguai que Lula não teve intenção de faltar com respeito e que fala foi retirada de contexto
item.description: Brazil's ambassador to Paraguay, José Marcondes, told Paraguayan officials that President Lula's remarks about the War of the Triple Alliance were taken out of context and not intended to offend. The meeting followed Paraguay's delivery of a protest note over Lula's comments, with Asunción emphasizing fraternal ties and proposing steps to heal historical wounds, including the return of Paraguayan cannons captured during the conflict.

item.title: ‘Ex-pardo’, ACM Neto se declara branco quatro anos após perder eleição em 2022
item.description: ACM Neto, former mayor of Salvador and União Brasil candidate, changed his racial self-declaration from 'pardo' to 'white' in the TSE for the 2026 elections, four years after declaring himself 'pardo' in 2022. The change reignites the 2022 controversy, when he was accused of electoral opportunism for identifying as 'pardo' in a state where 80.8% of the population is Black, according to the 2022 Census. The IBGE classifies both Black and 'pardo' as part of the Black population, and his earlier statement drew criticism from Black movements and opponents.

item.title: Aos 80 anos, Lula inicia última campanha presidencial com desafio de fazer eleitor sonhar com futuro
item.description: At 80, Lula launches his final presidential campaign at the same venue where his political journey began: the Estádio 1º de Maio in São Bernardo do Campo. The campaign aims to move beyond defending the PT legacy—now seen as acquired rights—by offering a vision of the future that resonates with contemporary Brazil, particularly to win over young voters, who are currently largely opposed to his re-election.

item.title: PRTB lança Leonardo Avalanche candidato à Presidência da República
item.description: The Brazilian Renewal Labor Party (PRTB) officially launched Leonardo Avalanche as its presidential candidate at a national convention held in Goiânia on Wednesday, the 29th. Avalanche, the party's national president, is a systems analyst and law graduate from Anápolis, Goiás. This marks the first time since 2014 that the PRTB has fielded a presidential candidate, having previously nominated Levy Fidelix.

item.title: Tarcísio oficializa candidatura amanhã com apoio de 95% dos prefeitos de SP
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) will officially announce his re-election bid tomorrow in the state capital, backed by 95% of the state’s mayors. A coalition with 12 parties gives him a platform in 614 of 645 municipalities, solidifying a strong political foundation for the campaign.

item.title: Líder com folga, Moro lança chapa pura pelo PL e dá palanque a Flávio no PR
item.description: Senator Sergio Moro officially launches his candidacy for Governor of Paraná at a PL state convention in Curitiba, without major alliances with the centrão. He will run on a pure PL ticket, providing a platform for Flávio Bolsonaro in the state. This move strengthens the Bolsonarist base in Paraná ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Entenda as idas e vindas na tentativa de levar Tereza Cristina à vice de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro continues to push for Tereza Cristina as his running mate despite the PP's formal neutrality in the 2026 elections. The effort, led by Valdemar Costa Neto and backed by agribusiness interests, faces internal resistance within the PP-União Brasil federation and personal tensions stemming from the Master case involving Ciro Nogueira. Tereza Cristina is seen as a strategic asset due to her executive experience, agribusiness ties, and potential to boost Flávio's appeal among female voters.

item.title: Ratinho Jr. acusa Lula de copiar programa de combate a violência contra a mulher
item.description: Paraná Governor Ratinho Junior (PSD) accused the Lula government of copying the state's 'Mulher Segura' program with the federal 'Alerta Mulher Segura' initiative, claiming it was launched opportunistically ahead of elections. The Paraná government states its program, active since May 2023, uses simultaneous electronic monitoring of victims and aggressors to combat gender-based violence with rapid security responses.

item.title: Michelle Bolsonaro avisa Valdemar Costa Neto sobre decisão envolvendo candidatura
item.description: Former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro told PL national president Valdemar Costa Neto she will decide by Sunday whether to run for Senate in the Federal District, following a discussion with ex-president Jair Bolsonaro. Her decision hinges on his health, which limits her travel, and she will not immediately resume leadership of PL Women. Valdemar is pushing for her candidacy after reconciling with Flávio Bolsonaro, who had previously disagreed with her.

item.title: Loteria leiloada por Tarcísio entra no ar com domínio '.bet' e jogos similares a caça-níqueis
item.description: The São Paulo State Lottery began online operations on July 1st via the domain 'dasorteloteria.bet', offering games similar to slot machines and roulette. Bets are placed exclusively through an Android app, with access currently limited to that operating system.

item.title: Análise: 'Não' do Republicanos mostra dificuldade de Flávio com evangélicos
item.description: The potential refusal of the Republicans party to support Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) in the presidential race highlights the senator’s difficulty in connecting with evangelical voters, according to political scientist Mayra Goulart on UOL News. This suggests that, despite his Bolsonarist base, Flávio faces obstacles in consolidating support among conservative religious leaders, who are crucial for national campaigns in Brazil.

item.title: Paraguai manifesta ‘repúdio’ por falas de Lula e faz cobrança para o Brasil
item.description: The Paraguayan government expressed 'repudiation' of President Lula's remarks about the War of the Triple Alliance, calling them a distorted view of national history. It demanded the return of cannons, documents, and military trophies retained by Brazil after the conflict and proposed measures to 'definitively close the wounds' of the war. The Paraguayan foreign ministry stressed that the issue must be addressed with responsibility, mutual respect, and a spirit of reconciliation.

item.title: PP decide ficar neutro na eleição presidencial
item.description: The Progressistas Party (PP) has decided to remain neutral in the 2026 presidential election, opting not to hold a national convention or endorse any candidate. The decision was made following consultations with state directories and confirmed by the party’s Senate leader, Senator Tereza Cristina. This neutrality prevents the Liberal Party (PL) from counting on her as a potential vice-presidential candidate on Flávio Bolsonaro’s ticket.

item.title: Caiado cita síndrome de Estocolmo em crítica a eleitores de Lula e Flávio
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado, pre-candidate for presidency from PSD, criticized voters of Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, claiming their sustained support despite high rejection rates resembles Stockholm syndrome. He accused Lula of using government machinery to shield his son, Lulinha, from investigations, and condemned the administration's foreign policy for creating diplomatic tensions with Argentina, the U.S., and Paraguay.

item.title: Move Brasil: BB e Caixa fazem parceria com Uber e 99 para dar cashback a quem aderir ao programa
item.description: Banco do Brasil and Caixa launched a cashback program for app drivers and taxi drivers who join the Move Brasil initiative, offering up to R$6,300 in refunds at Caixa and equivalent to 3.5 installments at BB, conditional on meeting trip and payment compliance. The measure aims to boost the program, which has fallen far short of its R$30 billion target, with realistic expectations of R$5 to R$6 billion in total contracts. Financing allows new vehicles up to R$150,000, with interest rates below the Selic and up to six months of grace period.

item.title: Chefe de comunicação do PT minimiza ‘impacto Lulinha’ sobre campanha de Lula
item.description: PT’s national communications secretary Éden Valadares downplayed the potential impact of the investigation into Lulinha, President Lula’s son, emphasizing that Lula will not use his office to grant privileges, unlike the Bolsonaro administration’s interference in Flávio Bolsonaro’s case. Lula stated in a podcast interview that if his son is guilty, he must face consequences like any other citizen, referencing his personal ordeal during Operation Car Wash and his wife’s death.

item.title: 'Quem vai decidir é o Bolsonaro', diz Valdemar sobre candidatura de Michelle Bolsonaro ao Senado
item.description: Valdemar Costa Neto stated that the decision on Michelle Bolsonaro’s Senate candidacy in the Federal District depends entirely on Jair Bolsonaro, as she is caring for him during house arrest. A final response is expected by Sunday, when the PL-DF will hold its convention. Michelle will not return as president of PL Mulher, with Ana Munhoz overseeing the role until the elections.

item.title: "Quem vai decidir é o Bolsonaro", diz Valdemar sobre candidatura de Michelle
item.description: Valdemar Costa Neto, national president of the PL, stated that the decision on Michelle Bolsonaro's Senate candidacy in the Federal District will be made by Jair Bolsonaro, whom she is currently caring for. He said the decision will likely be made by Sunday, the day of the PL-DF convention, which Michelle is expected to attend. He also noted that Michelle intends to resume leadership of PL Women after the elections.

item.title: Lula promove a marechal honorífico militar da Guerra do Paraguai
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva posthumously promoted Brigadier Antônio de Sampaio to the honorary rank of marshal in the Brazilian Army, recognizing his role in the Paraguayan War. The decree was published in the Official Gazette on July 30, 2026, shortly after Lula's remarks about Paraguay's historical invasion of Brazil sparked diplomatic tension, prompting Paraguay to condemn the statements as a distortion of history and summon Brazil's ambassador for clarification.

item.title: Novo lança Regina Tio Ivo ao Senado por Roraima
item.description: The New Party (Novo) has nominated Regina Aparecida da Silva, known as Regina Tio Ivo, as its Senate candidate for Roraima, although she did not attend the convention. A businesswoman in agribusiness, Regina was convicted by the STF for her role in the January 8 events but secured a non-prosecution agreement, requiring community service, a R$5,000 fine, a democracy and rule of law course, and a ban from open social media. Novo is running in coalition with the PL, which has nominated Arthur Henrique for governor and Haroldo Cathedral as vice-governor.

item.title: Paraguai pede ao Brasil devolução de troféus da guerra
item.description: Paraguayan Vice President Pedro Alliana delivered a formal note to Brazil requesting the return of war trophies, including the Presidente López and Cristiano cannons, along with historical documents and recognition of Paraguayan congressional resolutions on the Paraguayan War (1864-1870). The request followed remarks by Brazilian President Lula claiming Paraguay 'invaded Brazil', which Paraguayan authorities rejected as a historical distortion. Despite the protest tone, Alliana reaffirmed bilateral cooperation, citing Itaipu and Mercosul as partnership examples and advocating history as a foundation for mutual understanding and prosperity.

item.title: Maioria do Congresso vê caso Master como trunfo eleitoral para Lula
item.description: Most parliamentarians believe the Banco Master case currently favors President Lula electorally more than Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, according to a Ranking dos Políticos survey of federal deputies and senators. Although the case may still develop further, its present effects are seen as an electoral advantage for Lula’s 2026 campaign.

item.title: PT e governo preveem artilharia, mas se dividem sobre dano eleitoral de inquérito contra Lulinha
item.description: Allies of President Lula and the PT are divided on the potential electoral impact of the Federal Police investigation into Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, known as Lulinha, the president’s son. Some downplay the risks, while others fear damage to the petista’s image ahead of the 2026 elections. Lula’s team is closely monitoring shifts in public perception in the coming days.

item.title: Os bastidores da segunda troca de marqueteiro da campanha de Flávio
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro’s campaign replaced marketers Alexandre Oltramari and Eduardo Fischer with Duda Lima after internal criticism over poor visual identity, lack of strategy, and damage to the candidate’s image, exacerbated by public dissent from the party base. The change was facilitated by Senator Rogério Marinho, despite resistance from the Bolsonaro family, particularly Eduardo and Paulo Figueiredo, due to prior conflicts in Ricardo Nunes’ campaign. Duda Lima was selected for his strategic skills and ability to counter the PT, aiming to restore Flávio’s image ahead of the first-round showdown with Lula.

item.title: Michelle decide que disputará uma vaga ao Senado pelo DF
item.description: Former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro (PL) has confirmed she will run for a Senate seat from the Federal District in the 2026 elections. The decision followed a meeting with PL president Valdemar Costa Neto and aligns with the party’s regional convention in the DF, which will formalize its candidates. She will also attend her first public appearance with Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) since their reconciliation on July 23, after a public rift over electoral alliances and her role in PL Mulher.

item.title: Congresso avalia que caso Master beneficiará mais Lula do que Flávio, diz pesquisa
item.description: A survey by Ranking dos Políticos shows that most Brazilian congress members believe the Master case will benefit Lula (PT) more than Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) in the 2026 presidential election. While 49.1% of deputies and 57.1% of senators see an advantage for Lula, only 46.4% of deputies and 21.5% of senators believe Flávio will benefit. The survey, with a 6.5% margin of error and 95% confidence level, also found that 83.7% of deputies and 78.6% of senators expect further developments with political impact.

item.title: A esperança que a campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro ainda acalenta
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro’s (PL) campaign continues to seek alliances with the União Progressista federation, Podemos, and Republicanos to broaden national support, despite these parties leaning toward presidential election neutrality. Allies believe that in a polarized environment, center and center-right parties may ultimately gravitate toward the Bolsonaro ticket, offering more TV airtime and grassroots reach. Though challenging, the campaign remains hopeful of securing new partnerships before the election.

item.title: Quem é Tereza Cristina, e por que Flávio Bolsonaro a chamou de 'sonho de consumo' para vice em sua chapa
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) called Tereza Cristina (PP-MS) his 'dream pick' for vice president in 2026, but the Progressistas (PP) party maintained neutrality, blocking her nomination. The senator, former Agriculture Minister and agribusiness leader, is seen as a bridge between the Centrão and Bolsonaro’s base, and as a woman, she could help improve his standing with female voters. Although she accepted the invitation, the PP’s stance prevents formalizing the alliance, leaving the door open until August 5.
